reference.operation: Affix zIndexPopup defaults to zIndexBase+10 and is unitless. Raw CSS declarations and unfixed/fixed content CSS, measured top offset and flow placeholder for aliases/algorithms, zero/undefined, named cssVar, outer CSS overrides and nested/reset/sibling scopes. Per-control scroll hosts normalize viewport coordinates; no patched source or geometry mocks.
